e-4518.problem:
The system of equations

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}6x+4y=1 \\ x-8y-z=-2 \\ 3x+2y-2z=1\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

can be represented using matrix notation as

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14083420/assets/ed434344208758284aa0f144676f7dd6498a63faeb0248d18e87c4be6c3d87f2.png)

What are the values of $a,$ $b$ and $c?$
e-4518.worked_solution:
First, let's write the system so that $x$, $y$, and $z$ appear in each equation:

$$
{\begin{aligned}6x+4y+0z=1 \\ x-8y-z=-2 \\ 3x+2y-2z=1\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we can write the system in the form $A\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{b},$ where

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14083420/assets/b9364923447e278db5ec47bef74e1a05310645b30df22d4ea5efcc0de46c6ed2.png)

is the coefficient matrix,

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14083420/assets/16cb1608f70821d138f0c6984038bb42d86d9fbf76d560d94d2e25bd6fdb05e0.png)

is the column vector of constants, and

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14083420/assets/0abbbaf34955fa40d6cdbfa9e16cb1567ee16271d65b4565206a0f2204eedf6d.png)

is the column vector of variables.

So, the equation $A\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{b}$ becomes

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14083420/assets/4b915439c3e9922d692aab4205a728160e0a1286f82fa5ebc736460901581147.png)

Therefore, $a=6,$ $b=2,$ and $c=-2.$

e-4519.problem:
The system of equations

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}2x-y+z=4 \\ z-x+2=-1 \\ 2y-2x-4z=-4\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

can be represented using matrix notation as
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14083420/assets/c9b7abb2641034c1769c6fe6b13b96edd7ccc282b61424b2031a3d37faa456e4.png)
What are the values of $a,$ $b$ and $c?$
e-4519.worked_solution:
First, let's write the system so that $x$, $y$, and $z$ appear in each equation in the correct order and all constants are on the right-hand side of the system:

$$
{\begin{aligned}2x-y+z=4 \\ -x+0y+z=-3 \\ -2x+2y-4z=-4\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we can write the system in the form $A\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{b},$ where

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14083420/assets/6f1bf319faf8be4a9a79c0a6f9301e6eac48a5b04f66949b679e8445b07e9d9c.png)

is the coefficient matrix,

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14083420/assets/fc1ac06787ed64ebefbb1a7a82f9bf785525777f61831bbbc39bd25c7e629d5a.png)

is the column vector of constants, and

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14083420/assets/d0249dcecf6b75cd6ff7c4623beac6fd6cfae64a58d043bb6759440167f40ea1.png)

is the column vector of variables.

So, the equation $A\mathbf{x} = \mathbf{b}$ becomes

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14083420/assets/64d1f57717dda57c8a7fbc403728ee9699a22ce995f68a50a0b80f25543fdab6.png)

Therefore $a=0,$ $b=-2,$ $c=-3.$

after.problem:

$$
{\begin{aligned}3x+2y+8z=0 \\ 2x-5y+4z=3 \\ 5x-4y+7z=-2\end{aligned}
$$

can be represented using matrix notation as

$$
[\begin{aligned}3 & 2 & a \\ 2 & b & 4 \\ 5 & c & 7\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 3 \\ -2\end{aligned}].

What are the values of $a,b$ and $c?$
after.worked_solution:

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}3 & 2 & 8 \\ 2 & -5 & 4 \\ 5 & -4 & 7\end{aligned}]
$$

is the coefficient matrix,

$$
b=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 3 \\ -2\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of constants, and

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of variables.

So, the equation $Ax=b$ becomes

$$
[\begin{aligned}3 & 2 & 8 \\ 2 & -5 & 4 \\ 5 & -4 & 7\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 3 \\ -2\end{aligned}].
$$

content.knowledge_point: Identifying Entries of a Matrix Product Representing a 3x3 System of Equations
content.problem:
The system of equations

$$
{\begin{aligned}3x+2y+8z=0 \\ 2x-5y+4z=3 \\ 5x-4y+7z=-2\end{aligned}
$$

can be represented using matrix notation as

$$
[\begin{aligned}3 & 2 & a \\ 2 & b & 4 \\ 5 & c & 7\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 3 \\ -2\end{aligned}].
$$

What are the values of $a,b$ and $c?$
content.worked_solution:
We can write the system in the form $Ax=b,$ where

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}3 & 2 & 8 \\ 2 & -5 & 4 \\ 5 & -4 & 7\end{aligned}]
$$

is the coefficient matrix,

$$
b=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 3 \\ -2\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of constants, and

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of variables.

So, the equation $Ax=b$ becomes

$$
[\begin{aligned}3 & 2 & 8 \\ 2 & -5 & 4 \\ 5 & -4 & 7\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 3 \\ -2\end{aligned}].
$$

Therefore, $a=8,\,b=-5,\,c=-4.$

content.knowledge_point: Identifying Entries of a Matrix Product Representing a 3x3 System of Equations
content.problem:
The system of equations

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}y+2z=0 \\ x+2y+3z=2 \\ 3x+y+z=-3\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

can be represented using matrix notation as

$$
[\begin{aligned}0 & a & 2 \\ b & 2 & 3 \\ 3 & 1 & c\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 2 \\ -3\end{aligned}].
$$

What are the values of $a,b$ and $c?$
content.worked_solution:
First, let's write the system so that $x$, $y$, and $z$ appear in each equation:

$$
{\begin{aligned}0x+y+2z=0 \\ x+2y+3z=2 \\ 3x+y+z=-3\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we can write the system in the form $Ax=b,$ where

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 2 \\ 1 & 2 & 3 \\ 3 & 1 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

is the coefficient matrix,

$$
b=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 2 \\ -3\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of constants, and

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of variables.

So, the equation $Ax=b$ becomes

$$
[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 2 \\ 1 & 2 & 3 \\ 3 & 1 & 1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 2 \\ -3\end{aligned}].
$$

Therefore, $a=1,\,b=1,\,c=1.$

after.name: Question 6
after.problem:
The system of equations

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}-2z+x-5y=1 \\ -y+5z-4x=-2 \\ 2x-6y-z=2\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

can be represented using matrix notation as

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & -5 & a \\ b & -1 & 5 \\ 2 & c & -1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 2\end{aligned}].
$$

What are the values of $a,b$ and $c?$
after.worked_solution:
First, let's write the system so that $x$, $y$, and $z$ appear in each equation in the correct order and all constants are on the right-hand side of the system:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}x-5y-2z=1 \\ -4x-y+5z=-2 \\ 2x-6y-z=2\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we can write the system in the form $Ax=b,$ where

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}1 & -5 & -2 \\ -4 & -1 & 5 \\ 2 & -6 & -1\end{aligned}]
$$

is the coefficient matrix,

$$
b=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 2\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of constants, and

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of variables.

So, the equation $Ax=b$ becomes

$$
[\begin{aligned}1 & -5 & -2 \\ -4 & -1 & 5 \\ 2 & -6 & -1\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 2\end{aligned}].
$$

Therefore, $a=-2,\,b=-4,\,c=-6.$

content.problem:
The system of equations

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}z-5x+2y=0 \\ z=1-2x \\ 7y-3x-2z=0\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

can be represented using matrix notation as

$$
[\begin{aligned}-5 & a & 1 \\ 2 & 0 & 1 \\ -3 & 7 & c\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ b \\ 0\end{aligned}].
$$

What are the values of $a,b$ and $c?$
content.worked_solution:
First, let's write the system so that $x$, $y$, and $z$ appear in each equation in the correct order and all constants are on the right-hand side of the system:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}-5x+2y+z=0 \\ 2x+0y+z=1 \\ -3x+7y-2z=0\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we can write the system in the form $Ax=b,$ where

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}-5 & 2 & 1 \\ 2 & 0 & 1 \\ -3 & 7 & -2\end{aligned}]
$$

is the coefficient matrix,

$$
b=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of constants, and

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of variables.

So, the equation $Ax=b$ becomes

$$
[\begin{aligned}-5 & 2 & 1 \\ 2 & 0 & 1 \\ -3 & 7 & -2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}].
$$

Therefore, $a=2,\,b=1,\,c=-2.$

The system of equations

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}z-7x-5=0 \\ 4y-x-3z-2=0 \\ 2y+x-8=-2\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

 

can be represented using matrix notation as

$$
[\begin{aligned}-7 & 0 & 1 \\ -1 & 4 & a \\ b & 2 & 0\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 2 \\ c\end{aligned}].
$$

What are the values of $a,b,$ and $c?$
after.worked_solution:
First, let's write the system so that $x$, $y$, and $z$ appear in each equation in the correct order and all constants are on the right-hand side of the system:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}-7x+0y+z=5 \\ -x+4y-3z=2 \\ x+2y+0z=6\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we can write the system in the form $Ax=b,$ where

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}-7 & 0 & 1 \\ -1 & 4 & -3 \\ 1 & 2 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

is the coefficient matrix,

$$
b=[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 2 \\ 6\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of constants, and

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of variables.

So, the equation $Ax=b$ becomes

$$
[\begin{aligned}7 & 0 & 1 \\ -1 & 4 & -3 \\ 1 & 2 & 0\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 2 \\ 6\end{aligned}].
$$

Therefore, $a=-3,\,b=1,\,c=6.$

content.problem:
The system of equations

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}z-7x-5=0 \\ 4y-x-3z-2=0 \\ 2y+x-8=-2\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

 

can be represented using matrix notation as

$$
[\begin{aligned}-7 & 0 & 1 \\ -1 & 4 & a \\ b & 2 & 0\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 2 \\ c\end{aligned}].
$$

What are the values of $a,b,$ and $c?$
content.worked_solution:
First, let's write the system so that $x$, $y$, and $z$ appear in each equation in the correct order and all constants are on the right-hand side of the system:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}-7x+0y+z=5 \\ -x+4y-3z=2 \\ x+2y+0z=6\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we can write the system in the form $Ax=b,$ where

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}-7 & 0 & 1 \\ -1 & 4 & -3 \\ 1 & 2 & 0\end{aligned}]
$$

is the coefficient matrix,

$$
b=[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 2 \\ 6\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of constants, and

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]
$$

is the column vector of variables.

So, the equation $Ax=b$ becomes

$$
[\begin{aligned}7 & 0 & 1 \\ -1 & 4 & -3 \\ 1 & 2 & 0\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y \\ z\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 2 \\ 6\end{aligned}].
$$

Therefore, $a=-3,\,b=1,\,c=6.$
